basics.name: Kartikey Pandey
basics.label: Founding Engineer @ Raya Health
basics.summary: Software engineer and full-stack developer building scalable systems, cloud-native apps, and AI-driven solutions. Founding Engineer at Raya Health (HF0 W26). 10x hackathon winner across ML, computer vision, and full-stack. At Intel, built ML pipelines that cut deployment time 33%. At NASA's Lunar Autonomy Challenge (via JHU APL), worked on autonomous robotics with SLAM and AI frameworks. At Snap's Spectacles Accelerator, secured $25,000+ for AR/AI development. Built a diabetic retinopathy detection platform cutting diagnostic costs ~99.8%. Founder/President of Penn State's Collegiate Hackathon Team (#185 to #74 nationally) and President of GDSC @ Penn State (200+ students).
